newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index seen lower on tobacco stocks.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index seen lower on tobacco stocks.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be lower on Thursday on possible further selling in cigarette firms Sampoerna and Gudang Garam, brokers said.
Brokers and analysts have said concern over a slowdown in growth in the industry might continue to dampen sentiment towards both cigarette counters.
"Rumours of a possible share-swap between Sampoerna's founder and a Salim group shareholder has also put negative sentiment on Sampoerna," one broker with a foreign firm said.
Brokers said the overnight fall on Wall Street due to revived fears of inflation and rising U.S. interest rates as crude oil prices shot up, could also put pressure on the local market.
However, brokers said medium and small issues could still attract buyers.
On Wednesday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed down 0.13 percent at 712.50 points after hitting an intra-day low of 708.67 points.
